def main():
    input_line = input()
    input_parts = input_line.split()
    base = int(input_parts[0])
    number = int(input_parts[1])
    is_valid = True
    digits = []

    while number != 0:
        digits.append(number % base)
        number //= base

    for i in range(len(digits)):
        digit = digits[i]
        if digit == 0 or digit == 1:
            continue
        if digit == base - 1:
            j = i + 1
            while j < len(digits):
                if digits[j] == base - 1:
                    digits[j] = 0
                else:
                    digits[j] += 1
                    break
                j += 1
        else:
            is_valid = False
            break

    print("YES" if is_valid else "NO")

main()
